values.binNote: BriarW#TotalAttackBonusDamage = AttackBonusDamage + 1.05xad combines the 100% AD normal attack with the 5% bonus into one coefficient; only the 5% is this ability's bonus term, the rest is the base attack itself. mechanics.claim: Briar dashes and gains Blood Frenzy for 5 seconds only if there is a nearby enemy upon her arrival.
mechanics.quote: '''Briar''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} in the target direction. If there is a nearby enemy upon her arrival, she gains ''Blood Frenzy'' for 5 seconds

mechanics.claim: During Blood Frenzy, Briar is forced to basic attack the nearest enemy with an uncancellable windup, empowered to deal cleave damage.
mechanics.quote: become {{tt|forced|See notes}} to basic attack the nearest enemy ... gains {{tip|ghosting}}, {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, as well as empowering her basic attacks to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}} and deal {{as|physical damage}} to enemies surrounding her target

mechanics.claim: The cleave/bonus attack damage is affected by critical strike modifiers, and cleave crits if the main attack crits.
mechanics.quote: This damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.

mechanics.claim: Blood Frenzy resets Briar's basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: Blood Frenzy {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Briar's''' basic attack timer.

mechanics.claim: Snack Attack can only be cast during Blood Frenzy and is lost immediately if the frenzy ends.
mechanics.quote: ''Snack Attack'' can only be used during ''{{ai|Blood Frenzy|Briar}}''; if the frenzy ends at any point, the empowered attack will be lost immediately.

mechanics.claim: Snack Attack resets Briar's basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: Snack Attack {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Briar's''' basic attack timer.

mechanics.claim: Blood Frenzy's cooldown starts on cast, not on the frenzy ending.
Casting Chilling Scream (E) interrupts and ends Blood Frenzy early; Certain Death (R) can be cast during the frenzy without interrupting it.
mechanics.quote: ''{{ai|E|Briar}}'' interrupts the frenzy. ''{{ai|R|Briar}}'' can be cast during the frenzy without interrupting it.

mechanics.claim: Snack Attack heals Briar for a flat 5% of her maximum health plus a percentage of the post-mitigation damage dealt.
mechanics.quote: healing her for {{as|5% of her '''maximum''' health}} plus a percentage of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} dealt
